description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling FeaturePropertiesModified events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements the applyEvent method to update the feature properties of a ThingBuilder object based on the received event.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a strategy for handling FeaturePropertiesModified events, updating feature properties in a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to apply the FeaturePropertiesModified event to a ThingBuilder, setting new feature properties.
